# QR generator

> A browser tool that turns text or a link into a QR code.

The code is created in the browser. Nothing is uploaded. The code stores the text you type. Scanning it does not redirect through this site.

- Site: https://static-hosting.biradarakshay.com/
- Author: Akshay Biradar
- Author site: https://www.biradarakshay.com/

## What this site does not do

It does not run a QR redirect service, keep a scan history, or require an account.
